$comment: Core images pinned by this core release (ADR-0030, ADR-0065). The registry is instance config (coreImages.registry); the digest is the integrity anchor, and revision the commit core CI built the image from. A release pins the builds of its release branch with tools/scripts/release-images.mjs pin; core-release checks the pins (release-images.mjs check) and copies them to the public packages (docs/runbooks/release-core.md).
